content.short: Smart Places Protocol is a SocialFi project on Cardano that rewards users for real-world interactions.
content.description: Smart Places Protocol is a pioneering SocialFi application on the Cardano blockchain that introduces the 'Connect2Earn' model. The platform bridges real-life social engagement with digital rewards, allowing users to earn $SOCIAL tokens for interacting in physical locations verified via geolocation. Featuring 'Smartee IDs' as NFT-based verifiable identities, the project ensures that interactions are conducted by real people, enhancing the value of community data. By gamifying social networking, Smart Places Protocol incentivizes positive real-world connections and decentralized engagement.
